exposure: rates of GWG in second trimester
rates of GWG in third trimesters
cohort: 1606 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who delivered at 2010-2020 in Changzhou, Jiangsu
finding: GWG outside IOM guidelines increased risks of a range of adverse pregnancy outcomes among women with GDM.
mod_finding: Total GWG above IOM guidelines in pregnancy was associated with an increased odds of caesarean delivery, while GWG above IOM guidelines in the third trimester of pregnancy also increased the odds of caesarean delivery.
